profile.stage: Novice in strength; existing aerobic running base

mesocycle.note: Light-touch novice mesocycle, maintained by the Sunday weekly review. `week` counts COMPLETED weeks (>=3 logged sessions incl. both gym days); skipped weeks freeze the counter. Week 6 = deload: gym -1 set per exercise at same loads, both runs easy Z2, keep full mobility/splits (deload does NOT reduce mobility work). After deload, reset to 1. Everything else stays simple linear progression - no wave loading for a novice. Fatigue markers can pull the deload earlier.

GYM_A.label: Gym A — Full body
GYM_A.note: Keep 2–3 reps in reserve on every set — never to failure. Warm-up ~5 min: easy cardio + leg swings, arm circles, bodyweight squats ×10, scapular pulls ×10, glute bridge ×10.
GYM_A.mobility: Daily mobility minimum (~8–10 min) still applies.

GYM_B.label: Gym B — Full body
GYM_B.note: Keep 2–3 reps in reserve. Same warm-up as Gym A.
GYM_B.mobility: Daily mobility minimum (~8–10 min) still applies.

RUN_EASY.label: Easy run — Zone 2
RUN_EASY.purpose: Aerobic base and heart health. Conversational pace, never hard the day after legs.
options: Optional: 4–6 × 15–20 s relaxed strides at the end, full walk recovery
RUN_EASY.fueling: Fully fat-adapted is fine — no special fueling needed.

RUN_QUALITY.label: Quality run (easy in base phase)
RUN_QUALITY.purpose: Structured intensity once the base is consolidated. If legs are heavy from Thursday's gym, keep it easy.
options: Base phase (wks 1–3): easy Z2 run, 4–7 km
Threshold (wks 4–7): 10 min easy → 3–5 × 4–5 min comfortably hard / 2 min jog → cooldown
VO2max (wks 8+): warm-up + strides → 5–6 × 1 min hard / 2 min easy, or 8–10 × 60–90 s uphill
RUN_QUALITY.fueling: Optional small pre-run carb dose only for genuinely hard interval days if energy feels low.
RUN_QUALITY.prep: Leg swings 10/side + 5–10 min easy jog warm-up.

MOBILITY_FULL.label: Full mobility & splits session (~25–30 min)
MOBILITY_FULL.note: Stretch warm. Hold 45–90 s, 2–3 rounds, both sides evenly. Never force into sharp pain.

REST.label: Rest day
REST.note: Full recovery. Wednesday: add light mobility (~8–10 min daily minimum).

nutrition.style: Ketogenic, 3 meals/day. Working draft ~1,798 kcal — slightly below ~1,850 maintenance; add a protein/fat source to reach a small muscle-building surplus (~1,900 kcal).
fueling: Mostly easy running and novice gym work run fine fat-adapted — targeted carbs are rarely needed.
Optional small pre-run carb dose only for genuinely hard interval sessions if energy feels low.

supplements.name: Magnesium glycinate stack
supplements.dose: 320 mg Mg + 30 mg Zn + 2 mg Cu + 4.2 mg B6

nutrition.notes: Macros computed from her stats (164 cm / 52 kg / 24 yo / ~23% bf), not scaled from anyone else's plan.
